name: The Nutty Irishman

evidence.note: Venue tour page says the back bar has a large hardwood dance floor, with DJs between band sets and a Tuesday country night where dancers teach the steps.
Weekly Tuesday Country Night listing with a DJ and line-dancing lessons.
Visitor review mentions line-dancing songs, two bar areas and a large dance floor.

dancing.notes: The back room has a large wood dance floor. Tuesday is country night with line-dance lessons, and on Friday and Saturday people dance to cover bands and DJs.

description: A big bar and restaurant on Main Street in Farmingdale village with a front pub, a back room with a stage, and an outdoor bar. It is known for weekend cover bands, DJs and a weekly country night.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's List has a venue page (/nuttyirishman). Farmingdale village is in Nassau County (Town of Oyster Bay). The Nutty Country Facebook page (facebook.com/NuttyCountry) is a separate page for the Tuesday country night. Faces for Radio gig on Oct 3 was not checked on the venue calendar.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The venue website (thenuttyirishman.com, a Wix site) could not be reached from our research machine on Oct 4, 2026 (connection reset in both a script and a browser), so we could not check it directly, pull the logo or photos, or confirm hours and email. Facts above come from search results and third-party pages and match our current data. Hours reported by 94.3 The Shark (citing the venue site): closed Mon; Tue-Thu 5 PM-close; Fri 5 PM-4 AM; Sat 12 PM-4 AM; Sun 12 PM-12 AM; not recorded until checked on the venue site. Instagram: one third-party site gives @nuttyfarmingdale, and Nutty Country uses @nuttycountry (instagram.com/nuttycountry); neither confirmed from the venue site, so not recorded. Please re-run this entity when the site is reachable. Existing description still fits; kept.

evidence.note: Radio station venue page (from search) lists The Nutty Irishman at 323 Main St, Farmingdale, phone 516-293-9700, and points to thenuttyirishman.com.
Search results show the venue's own Nutty Country page: Tuesday country night with live country bands, DJs and line dance lessons.
